digest.component_or_area: store push pipeline — logging and operator visibility
propositions: Expected best-effort ticket-branch push failures (lost contention races, transient transport retries, routine unpushed backlog) are surfaced at WARNING level with wording that primes LLM agents to assume store corruption, causing agents to halt and investigate non-issues.
Mid-retry transient transport notices in push_classify and push_recovery are logged at INFO/WARNING despite automatic retry logic making them non-actionable noise.
Unpushed commit count messages reference bare `..HEAD` (tracker HEAD, not session worktree HEAD) without stating the self-healing contract, causing ambiguous escalation across concurrent sessions.

Policy declines, strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlogs must remain at WARNING level as genuine operator-actionable signals; normal contention and static backlogs must be demoted to DEBUG or below.
